summary: T1 item 8: measurements/characterization.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ (or layout/ldo-core/reports/) evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated by measurements/build_characterization_report.py, never hand-edited, byte-reproducible against an unchanged tree, and carries a --check mode that fails when it has drifted from the evidence it cites. Item 8 asks for that aggregation artifact to exist and be current -- it does NOT ask for every row in it to pass, and this pass verdict must not be read as if it did: the report currently reads FAIL on 8 of the 13 rows that carry a graded verdict (Dropout, Load regulation, Load transient, PSRR, Iq, Startup/soft-start, Area, Stability), PASS on 5 (Output, Line regulation, Current limit, Enable/shutdown, Thermal), and N/A on 3 further rows. Area gained its first verdict with issue #236 (routed core 0.4468 mm2 against the ratified < 0.1 mm2: FAIL, kept honestly; no bound was touched); issue #318 re-measured the current routed core at 0.4508 mm2, still FAIL, with the four schematic capacitors not drawn, official-deck DRC FAIL and LVS stale disclosed in the area record. Output moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #164: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- only the mc-output-accuracy bench's initial-condition contract, see design/README.md "#164". Thermal moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #189, on the same footing: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- one value in the sim/thermal bench's `.nodeset` seed card (EA_TAIL) was written as if it tracked VIN when a three-supply measurement puts its supply slope at 0.24 V/V, which is what left two corners tripping the #171 solver-diagnostic gate in the superseded record; correcting it takes the bench to 15/15 PASS with zero solver diagnostics. See sim/README.md "#189". Line regulation moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #196, on that same footing: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- the sim/line-regulation bench drove EN at the corner runner's 'vsup' label while its own VVIN was 'alter'ed 2.97-3.63V INSIDE every corner, so the VIN=3.63V point of every *_2.97v corner ran with EN 0.66V below VIN, which is #187's EN-below-VIN geometry (five PMOS shutdown clamps whose sources are VIN) and leaves no solver diagnostic for the #171 gate to catch. With EN at the instantaneous VIN the full 45-corner matrix is 45/45 PASS (worst 0.595 mV/V at 1mA, 0.368 mV/V at 50mA, against the ratified 5 mV/V bound), and the superseded record's five FAILing corners were exactly the *_125c_2.97v column. See sim/README.md "#196". Those FAILs are item 5's subject matter and item 5 is unmet here. See signoff/README.md for the full reading. Startup/soft-start moved PASS -> FAIL with issue #336 on measurement grounds alone: the row's evidence record is now the operator-authorised 12-leg C_out x load x ESR cold-enable grid run over the full 45-point PVT matrix on the batch backend (sim/startup/records/20261117-221657-efb6bd6b, supersedes 20260825-110456-933dfdd for this row). The 20260825 record predated issue #309 and never measured ramp monotonicity, so its PASS covered overshoot and the settled window only; the new record grades the direct monotonicity predicate at the unchanged strict 0 V tolerance and every one of the 540 leg conditions fails it by 0.016-66 uV drawdowns in the first ~20 us after the enable edge (the open decision-record question in sim/README.md, "Startup ramp monotonicity"), while all 1620 electrical conditions PASS (vpk <= 1.8246 V against the 1.836 V ceiling, vfloor >= 1.79836 V against the 1.764 V floor). No ratified bound and no DUT change -- see sim/README.md "Startup ESR grid (issue #336)". The regeneration also cites records already on main for Output (20261112-110113-820ba8b3), PSRR and Stability (20261029 pair) and Iq (20261110-223334-f66373a0) whose superseding records had landed without a rollup re-cut; their verdicts are unchanged (Output PASS; PSRR/Iq/Stability FAIL, now marked PVT subset where the newer records are subsets). The same new hash is carried, edited in place, by signoff/artifact-pins.json (item 8), signoff/records/t1-tier-report.json and signoff/block-manifest.json.
